start_id.note: Source reference to the start node.

end_id.note: Source reference to the end node.

distance.note: Link length in metres, recorded to one decimal place; geometry agreement still requires dataset validation.

ordinal.note: Floor/vertical order; outdoor ground is 0, indoor floors use ordered integers, and intermediate levels use decimals.

in_out.note: 1 outside a facility, 2 facility boundary, 3 inside a facility.

rt_struct.note: 1 separated sidewalk, 2 unseparated, 3 crossing, 4 unmarked crossing, 5 underground passage, 6 pedestrian bridge, 7 indoor passage, 8 other, 99 unknown.

route_type.note: 1 none, 2 moving walkway, 3 railway crossing, 4 elevator, 5 escalator, 6 stairs, 7 ramp, 99 unknown.

width.note: 1 under 1m, 2 from 1m to under 2m, 3 from 2m to under 3m, 4 at least 3m, 99 unknown.

vtcl_slope.note: 1 at most 5%, 2 over 5% rising start-to-end, 3 over 5% falling start-to-end, 99 unknown.

elevator.note: 1 none, 2 not accessibility-equipped, 3 wheelchair-equipped, 4 visually-impaired-equipped, 5 both, 99 unknown.
